notes.title: Etcetera and Otherwise is live. Indecency for a modest price.
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059798/a1851734838c54083a4821067ec421c818d46c77.png"][/img][/p][p]If you enjoy this linear visual novel, please share it with like-minded debauchees. The more bawdiness we have in this world, the more obscenity we will have, and we all know how nice that kind of world will be, what with flowers and sundresses and jawlines and tall glasses of pastis and what-have-you.[/p]

notes.title: Etcetera and Otherwise: A Lurid Odyssey demo out now!
notes.notes:
"There was no fear in our understanding of the Inter Organic Creeping. It was as unavoidable as a coffin pillow. There was no sadness or sense of loss that one day we would dissolve into the deep green swamp. The swamp was warm and seething and had mysteries that would never be revealed by the brittle, antiseptic minds of experts. We knew that to become organically disposed was to become free, free even of freedom ... and what’s to be afraid of in that?"
